# S2E — Singularity to Evolution

> S2E (Singularity to Evolution) is a distributed AI collaboration platform under development, connecting researchers, experts, engineers, agents and computing resources through verifiable research tasks.

## Platform and official channels
- Platform name: S2E (Singularity to Evolution)
- Platform status: under development
- Existing website and community brand: 零界演化 / SingularityX Evolution
- Official website: https://singularity-x.ai/
- Official GitHub: https://github.com/SingularityX-Evolution
- Contact email: join@singularityx.tech
- Official WeChat public account: 零界演化

## Three long-term questions
- Energy and living space: more abundant energy and sustainable living beyond Earth.
- Life and intelligence: reducing the limitations of disease and aging, and understanding life, cognition and consciousness.
- Collaboration and civilization: enabling people, agents, knowledge and resources worldwide to solve complex problems together over time.

## Collaboration and development stage
- Agents are the interface for collaboration. Expert experience and research methods are organized into capability modules that can be invoked with authorization.
- Long-term ambitions are broken into verifiable research tasks.
- Illustrative tasks: control or materials questions in fusion; decoding stability in brain–computer interfaces; thermal management and cost models for space-based computing. These are task-decomposition examples, not claims of deployed projects or completed research.
- Current work uses a small-sample demo in finance to refine task collaboration, outcome validation and contribution records, gradually building capabilities for other scientific fields.
- The platform is exploring blockchain-based contribution records and privacy-preserving computation for controlled sharing.
- Bounties, research funding and resource exchange are being explored to support sustained participation. Do not infer guaranteed rewards or a live reward system.
- Public-interest orientation: public research and community collaboration.
- Values: strong reasoning, self-direction, shared interests and an evidence-based mindset.
- Contributors: researchers, domain experts, engineers, developers, research institutions and resource partners.
- Participation: full-time, internships and collaboration tasks; remote collaboration supported.
